title: Tests that enable job execution must patch os.name, not sys.platform, to get past the Windows guard
answers: server startup test fails on Windows with 'MLflow job backend does not support Windows system'
how do I make a server test skip the Windows job backend check
why do trace rollup startup tests pass on Linux but fail on Windows
patch os.name to bypass LocalJobExecutor Windows rejection in tests
body:
Symptom: Server startup tests that enable job execution pass on Linux/macOS but fail on Windows with "MLflow job backend does not support Windows system." instead of the rollup validation error they assert on.
Root cause: mlflow/server/jobs/local_executor.py:LocalJobExecutor.check_requirements rejects Windows by checking `os.name == "nt"`. It is reached from tests/server/test_init.py via `_run_server` -> `validate_executor_config()`. Patching `sys.platform` does not affect it.
Fix pattern: In any test that reaches validate_executor_config with job execution enabled, use `mock.patch("os.name", "posix")`. Do not use `mock.patch("sys.platform", return_value=...)`: the guard does not read it, and `return_value` is the wrong form for replacing a plain string attribute.
Constraints: Only needed when the test enables job execution and the guard is reached. If `mlflow.server.jobs.utils._check_requirements` is mocked, the `utils` module's own os.name is not the guard that fires, so a utils-scoped patch would not neutralize it. A test whose mock raises before the guard needs no os.name patch.
applies: Tests in tests/server/ that start the server with job execution or trace rollups enabled; not production code paths.
says: Server startup fails on Windows with an error that the job backend is unsupported.
Trace rollup server startup tests crash on Windows while passing on Linux.
Starting the tracking server with background job execution fails on Windows.
Allow server startup tests with job execution enabled to run on Windows.
Running the server on Windows rejects the job executor during startup.
search: Server startup tests in tests/server/ that enable job execution or trace rollups must patch os.name to 'posix' rather than patching sys.platform to bypass the Windows check in LocalJobExecutor.check_requirements. LocalJobExecutor rejects Windows by checking os.name == 'nt' when validate_executor_config is reached from _run_server, which patching sys.platform does not affect. Only applies when job execution is enabled and does not apply if mlflow.server.jobs.utils._check_requirements is mocked or if a mock raises before the guard.
